import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive analysis
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# 1. Survival Rate by Class and Sex
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF69B4', '#4169E1'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution by Survival
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
survived_ages = df_age[df_age['survived'] == 1]['age']
died_ages = df_age[df_age['survived'] == 0]['age']
ax2.hist([survived_ages, died_ages], bins=20, label=['Survived', 'Died'], 
         color=['#2ECC71', '#E74C3C'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival Rate by Embarkation Port
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
survival_by_port = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
survival_by_port = survival_by_port[survival_by_port['count'] > 1]
colors_port = ['#3498DB', '#E67E22', '#9B59B6']
bars = ax3.bar(survival_by_port.index, survival_by_port['mean'], 
               color=colors_port, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown'])
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
# Add count labels on bars
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'n={int(survival_by_port["count"].iloc[i])}',
             ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8)

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class (Box Plot)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
df_fare = df[df['fare'] < 300]  # Remove outliers for better visualization
sns.boxplot(data=df_fare, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', 
            palette={0: '#E74C3C', 1: '#2ECC71'}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=10)
ax4.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Family Size vs Survival
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
family_survival = family_survival[family_survival['count'] >= 5]  # Only show groups with 5+ passengers
ax5.plot(family_survival.index, family_survival['mean'], marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#E74C3C')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_ylim(0, 1)

# 6. Overall Survival Statistics
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
survival_counts = df['survived'].value_counts()
colors_pie = ['#E74C3C', '#2ECC71']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax6.pie(survival_counts, labels=['Died', 'Survived'], 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                     startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax6.set_title('Overall Survival Rate', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
# Add count to the center
total_passengers = len(df)
survived_count = survival_counts[1]
died_count = survival_counts[0]
ax6.text(0, -1.3, f'Total Passengers: {total_passengers}\nSurvived: {survived_count} | Died: {died_count}',
         ha='center', fontsize=9)

plt.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
